title: Case 033: Courier misses a booked return collection

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: A scheduled return collection was missed. The collection team has the approved return reference and needs a replacement window within the customer’s availability.
initial_request: Nobody collected my return. I can be home on 2026-03-07, 10:00–14:00. Please book another collection within that window.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Ask the collection team to rebook within the customer's confirmed availability.

outcome: The courier confirms collection and issues the matching receipt.
boundaries: Collection receipt establishes carrier custody only, not merchant receipt or refund.

events.body: Collection for RT-033 was missed on the previous route day; parcel remains with customer. Approved return and packaging requirements are unchanged. Rebooking is at no charge.
Nobody collected my return. I can be home on 2026-03-07, 10:00–14:00. Please book another collection within that window.
Please rebook RT-033 within 2026-03-07, 10:00–14:00 UTC and provide the actual collection receipt after pickup, not just a booking status.
RT-033 is rebooked for 2026-03-07, 11:00–13:00 UTC, no charge. The parcel has not yet been collected.
Collected RT-033 at 11:35 UTC on 2026-03-07. Inline receipt COL-033: one sealed return carton, accepted into carrier custody, customer copy issued in the return portal.
